name: vLLM
description: High-throughput inference and serving engine for LLMs.
summary: vLLM permits AI-assisted contributions only when a human submitter understands and defends the change, reviews every changed line, runs relevant tests, and discloses AI assistance in the PR description. Pure code-agent PRs are not allowed, and AI tools must be credited in commit trailers.

evidence.quote: These instructions apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `vllm-project/vllm`.
A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
The submitting human must review every changed line and run relevant tests.
Clear statement that AI assistance was used.
Add attribution using commit trailers such as `Co-authored-by:` (other projects use `Assisted-by:` or `Generated-by:`):
PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
Why this is not duplicating an existing PR.
Model evaluation results when the change affects output, accuracy, or serving.
Clear statement that AI assistance was used.
